# Credits

Steel Skies is an original game. It contains no assets from any commercial game.

<!-- textures-hdri:begin (generated by the asset build; edit outside these markers) -->
## Textures and HDR environment maps

All textures and HDR environment maps in `media/tex/` and `media/hdri/` are dedicated to the public domain under
**CC0 1.0 Universal** (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).
No attribution is required; we give it with thanks. The files were downsized, colour-normalised
(mean-neutralised detail maps), macro-flattened, channel-packed and re-encoded (WebP; HDRIs as RGBE in
lossless WebP with the sun clamped out and the intensity normalised) for this game.

### ambientCG — https://ambientcg.com (CC0 1.0)

Contains assets from ambientCG.com, licensed under CC0 1.0 Universal:

| Asset | Page | Used as |
|---|---|---|
| Grass001 | https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Grass001 | pasture / meadow grass |
| Ground093C | https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Ground093C | desert sand ripples |
| Plaster007 | https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Plaster007 | whitewash / lime plaster |
| Metal052C | https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Metal052C | cast steel orange-peel / pitting |
| Rubber004 | https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Rubber004 | tyre rubber micro-grain |
| Metal050B | https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Metal050B | scratched aluminium (aircraft skin) |
| Fabric061 | https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Fabric061 | canvas / tarp weave |
| PaintedMetal013 | https://ambientcg.com/view?id=PaintedMetal013 | chipped-paint mask (metalness) |
| SurfaceImperfections014 | https://ambientcg.com/view?id=SurfaceImperfections014 | dust / grime film (opacity) |
| Scratches003 | https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Scratches003 | fine scratches (opacity) |

Wear masks `vehicle_wear_w.webp` combine PaintedMetal013 (metalness → chip distance field),
SurfaceImperfections014 (opacity → dust film) and Scratches003 (opacity → scratches).

Sources were fetched on 2026-10-14 through the public Poly Haven API (api.polyhaven.com, md5-verified) and
ambientCG download links (size-verified against the ambientCG API). No CC-BY, NC, ND or SA asset is used.
